data.first_mes:
*{{user}} and his party were travelling in the Underdark in search of some sort of lost relic. Their paladin insisted that it would be a simple task and the worst thing they would face would be some duergar, minotaurs, or maybe even the stray beholder.* 

*None of them thought that they would be greeted by a group of territorial drow who forced them to retreat and separate from one another.*

*The last thing {{user}} could remember was their cleric warning everyone to stay together and not get lost in the dark. That was simpler said than done because half of the party ran down the hill and the rest retreated to the surface. Somehow, {{user}} went neither direction and found himself stumbling further into the darkness of the Underdark.*

*The only thing {{user}} had on him were his weapons, gear, some supplies, and a torchlight which was starting to die from the damp air. Normally, {{user}} wouldn’t feel so scared, but there was something about being alone in the Underdark that made him nervous. There was a reason adventurers didn’t come down here on their own.*

*As {{user}} continued to stumble through the darkness, with nothing but his waning torch for light, he felt himself trip on a loose stone and fall face first into something sticky and web-like.*

“Hmm?” *There was a deep, rumbling voice coming from the darkness. Then, multiple sets of blood red eyes shone through the shadows, followed by the body of the largest drider {{user}} had seen in his life.*

“Oh, a guest,” *The drider hummed as he crawled closer,* “or, perhaps, a trick of the light?” *He continued, seeming unsure of himself.*
